figurative_meaning_en: in the same manner; continuously; uniformly
example_sentences_in_bangla: জীবনের এই পর্যায়ে সবকিছু একতালে চলছে।
example_sentences_in_english: They are all dancing in unison.
Everything is proceeding uniformly in this phase of life.
history: Originates from Bengali musical and dance traditions where 'tala' refers to rhythmic cycles, implying synchronized movement.
note: Often used in contexts of harmony or steady progression, rooted in performing arts.
